select ui.user_id, ua.user_name, ui.avatar, ui.profile, true as followed, COALESCE(fan_stats.fan_count, 0) as fan_count, COALESCE(follow_stats.follow_count, 0) as follow_count, ur.create_time as follow_time from user_relation ur left join user_info ui on ur.follow_user_id = ui.user_id left join user_account ua on ui.user_id = ua.id left join ( select follow_user_id, count(*) as fan_count from user_relation where follow_state = 1 and deleted = 0 group by follow_user_id ) fan_stats on ui.user_id = fan_stats.follow_user_id left join ( select user_id, count(*) as follow_count from user_relation where follow_state = 1 and deleted = 0 group by user_id ) follow_stats on ui.user_id = follow_stats.user_id
ur.user_id = #{queryParam.userId} and ur.follow_state = 1 and ur.deleted = 0 and ua.deleted = 0
and ua.user_name like concat('%', #{queryParam.userName}, '%')
order by ur.create_time desc

select ui.user_id, ua.user_name, ui.avatar, ui.profile, IF(mutual.follow_user_id IS NOT NULL, true, false) as followed, COALESCE(fan_stats.fan_count, 0) as fan_count, COALESCE(follow_stats.follow_count, 0) as follow_count, ur.create_time as follow_time from user_relation ur left join user_info ui on ur.user_id = ui.user_id left join user_account ua on ui.user_id = ua.id left join ( select follow_user_id from user_relation where user_id = #{queryParam.followUserId} and follow_state = 1 and deleted = 0 ) mutual on mutual.follow_user_id = ui.user_id left join ( select follow_user_id, count(*) as fan_count from user_relation where follow_state = 1 and deleted = 0 group by follow_user_id ) fan_stats on ui.user_id = fan_stats.follow_user_id left join ( select user_id, count(*) as follow_count from user_relation where follow_state = 1 and deleted = 0 group by user_id ) follow_stats on ui.user_id = follow_stats.user_id
ur.follow_user_id = #{queryParam.followUserId} and ur.follow_state = 1 and ur.deleted = 0 and ua.deleted = 0
and ua.user_name like concat('%', #{queryParam.userName}, '%')
order by ur.create_time desc
